Several legs and claws are visible, tucked beneath or extending from the body. In the background, there is another partial crab shell and some blurry dining environment elements (glass, table).

The texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine granular detail or natural imperfections of a real crab shell. It resembles a 3D render more than a photograph.
The rim of the plate in the background seems to warp slightly inconsistently with the foreground perspective, though this is minor.
